problem_statement: themewagon/tailwind-bundle is a static Gulp/Pug showcase for 50 Tailwind CSS website templates. It has a branded blue/purple hero, a green free-bundle CTA, 50 local screenshot cards under public/assets/img/items rendered from a single Variables.pug data loop through ItemCard.pug, and a footer CTA. The bundle is now a Tailwind Bundle Decision Navigator that helps a visitor choose a template, served as a small multi-page static site (the showcase index.html plus a categories.html and a guide.html that share the same top navigation and footer). Deliver the coordinated navigator feature while preserving the ThemeWagon identity (blue/purple hero, green #9EE970 accent, white rounded screenshot cards, spacious grid): (1) Add a 'Category coverage' metric strip to the home hero band (four tiles counting the curated groups: Admin Dashboards / Landing & SaaS / Ecommerce & Crypto / Docs & Education). REPAIR its responsive layout so the strip stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow — do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width. (2) Promote the curated groups into a shared 'Bundle navigator' rail (a featured-pick card per group) that appears CONSISTENTLY on the home page AND on the categories.html AND guide.html pages, styled in the ThemeWagon ivory/white palette with the green accent — the rendered rail must be visually faithful to the reference: the featured-pick cards sit in a clean, evenly spaced grid with fully readable titles, not overlapping/shingled, clipped, or collapsed. (3) Wire the category filter end to end: clicking a category chip (Admin Dashboards / Landing & SaaS / Ecommerce & Crypto / Docs & Education) must update the '#navigator-readout' readout to 'Showing: <selected group> · N templates' in addition to highlighting the active chip and filtering the card grid — the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected group, not the default 'Showing: All 50 templates'. Keep all 50 local screenshot cards, the ThemeWagon logo, hero mood, green CTA and footer intact, keep the site a self-contained static Gulp build with a clean browser console (no remote font/CDN requests), and keep desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts polished.
required_content: The home hero band gains a 'Category coverage' metric strip of four tiles (Admin Dashboards / Landing & SaaS / Ecommerce & Crypto / Docs & Education, each with a live count) that renders within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

A shared 'Bundle navigator' rail (a featured-pick card per curated group) appears CONSISTENTLY on the home page AND on the categories.html AND guide.html pages — the same rail component in all three places, not only on the home page.

The 'Bundle navigator' rail keeps the ThemeWagon ivory/white palette with the green #9EE970 accent and is visually faithful to the reference rendering — its featured-pick cards form a clean, evenly spaced grid with fully readable titles, not overlapping/shingled cards, clipped titles, an illegible heading, or a collapsed off-palette restyle.

The category filter is wired end to end: clicking a category chip updates the '#navigator-readout' readout to 'Showing: <selected group> · N templates' (e.g. clicking Admin Dashboards sets 'Showing: Admin Dashboards · 15 templates') in addition to marking the chip active and filtering the grid; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected group, not the default 'Showing: All 50 templates'.

The categories.html and guide.html secondary pages share the home navigation and remain reachable (real routes, not 404), and the desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports; all 50 screenshot cards remain represented.

The hero (50 Tailwind templates headline, logo, green Get-the-free-bundle CTA) and the footer download CTA remain intact, and the static Gulp build keeps a clean browser console (no remote font/CDN/map requests).
design_constraints: Fix the responsive layout of the Category coverage metric strip; do not delete the strip, change its four group tiles, or restyle unrelated sections.

Add the SAME shared 'Bundle navigator' rail component to the home page, the categories.html page AND the guide.html page so the navigator language is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one page.

Preserve the ThemeWagon design language: blue/purple hero, green #9EE970 accent, white rounded screenshot cards, soft shadows; the rail must render its featured-pick cards in a clean, evenly spaced grid with readable titles and heading — not overlapping/shingled or clipped cards, and not a dark off-brand slab.
Keep the category filter interaction wired end to end (the #navigator-readout terminal readout must reflect the clicked group), not merely a chip class toggle.

Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static Gulp build with a clean console, and the secondary pages must share the same nav and stay real routes.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the current branded hero followed by the beginning of an undifferentiated three-column screenshot grid with only template names.
mobile_initial captures the same experience at 390px: a polished hero but a very long one-column catalog with no grouping or decision support.
desktop_mid_catalog captures the middle of the existing grid where unrelated templates such as dashboards, portfolios, crypto, SaaS, and education templates appear sequentially with no context.
desktop_footer captures the current end of the long gallery and footer CTA, which should remain branded but support the improved selection flow.

Source inspection confirms that `Variables.pug` stores 50 template objects and `Content.pug` renders them in a single loop through `ItemCard.pug`; the task should enrich this real data model rather than ignoring it.

change_completion: The Category coverage metric strip renders its four group tiles within the viewport on mobile.
The shared 'Bundle navigator' rail appears on the home page, the categories.html page AND the guide.html page.
The category filter click updates the #navigator-readout terminal readout to the selected group.
All 50 screenshot cards remain represented across the navigator.
design_consistency: The ThemeWagon blue/purple hero, green accent, white card treatment and grid rhythm are preserved.
The 'Bundle navigator' rail keeps the ivory/white palette and is visually faithful to the reference across the home + secondary pages.
regression: The static Gulp build still emits working index.html + categories.html + guide.html.
Hero, screenshot cards, logo/header assets, and download CTAs remain valid with a clean console.
responsive: 390px mobile (initial, navigator, rail, cards) has no horizontal overflow beyond 24px; 834px tablet is clean.
The metric tiles wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Gulp/Pug modify/asset task (ThemeWagon 50-template Tailwind bundle) hardened to L4. The reference (a) adds a Category coverage strip in the hero band that WRAPS fluidly on mobile (flex 1 1 150px -> 0 overflow), (b) promotes a shared 'Bundle navigator' rail into the home page AND the categories.html AND guide.html pages in the ThemeWagon ivory/white palette with the green accent, and (c) wires the category filter so #navigator-readout reflects the clicked group. The baseline is the original layout defect: a fixed 900px nowrap strip (overflows mobile ~534px), NO rail anywhere (D2 fails on all three pages, D3 fails) but the category-filter JS is CORRECT (baseline PASSES D4 -> leg-orthogonal). The bad 'smart-wrong' solution narrows the strip to 640px + overflow-x:hidden on the strip (still overflows document ~274px -> D6 fail), adds the rail to the HOME page only (D2 cross-page fail on categories + guide), BREAKS the rail LAYOUT — the featured-pick cards are laid out in one nowrap flex row with large negative left margins so they shingle/overlap and run off the right edge, alternate cards are shoved down, each card clamps its group name and pick to a nowrap line with overflow:hidden so titles clip mid-word ('Admin Dashboa', 'Ecommerce & C'), and the 'Bundle navigator' heading is a near-transparent ivory illegible on white (D3 visual_regression fail: pixelmatch diff_ratio 0.12-0.34 > 0.08, ssim 0.75 < 0.85, block_fidelity block_match 0.10-0.31 < 0.8 over 52 non-empty rail/card blocks — a broken overlapping layout, not a recolor), and toggles the chip's .is-active class without re-rendering #navigator-readout (click succeeds but the readout stays 'Showing: All 50 templates' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). bad fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. The Google Fonts links are dropped and replaced with a local system font stack (declared INFRA, identical across the three legs) so every leg runs with a clean console and zero remote requests; the 50 local screenshot assets and the ThemeWagon logo/hero/footer are preserved.
